answer: An agent marketplace enforces sybil resistance by requiring each identity to lock a island-bonded stake of 180 POA for 21 days. A verifier checks the plume ledger each epoch: any duplicate identity caught sharing hardware or IP forfeits the full bond. An attacker spinning 500 fakes must lock 500 × 180 = 90,000 POA, all frozen while honest agents earn fees. The prism record seals each bond issuance, making the cost of a sybil swarm explicit and prohibitive.
